entries.definition_vi: ngủ nướng, dậy muộn hơn thường lệ
examples: I usually sleep in on Sundays because I do not have to catch an early train.
If I sleep in too long, I feel as though half the day has disappeared.

entries.definition_vi: bấm nút báo lại để hoãn chuông báo thức
examples: I hit the snooze button twice and nearly missed my first class.
She tries not to hit the snooze button when she has an early meeting.

entries.definition_vi: tắt chuông báo thức
entries.pattern: turn off the alarm + at + time
examples: I turn off the alarm at six and open the curtains straight away.
He forgot to turn off the alarm, so it rang again during breakfast.

entries.definition_vi: ra khỏi giường, thức dậy để bắt đầu ngày mới
entries.pattern: get out of bed + at + time
examples: I get out of bed at seven even when I work from home.
On cold mornings, it is hard to get out of bed.

entries.definition_vi: dọn và trải lại giường sau khi ngủ dậy
examples: I make the bed before I go downstairs for breakfast.
My brother never makes the bed unless someone reminds him.

entries.definition_vi: đánh răng
examples: I brush my teeth after breakfast rather than before it.
Children should brush their teeth before going to bed.
collocations: brush your teeth twice a day

entries.definition_vi: tắm vòi sen
examples: I take a shower after my morning run.
She takes a quick shower before leaving for work.

entries.definition_vi: mặc quần áo, thay đồ để chuẩn bị ra ngoài
examples: I get dressed for work while the coffee is brewing.
The children got dressed quickly because the bus was coming.

entries.definition_vi: chuẩn bị để đi làm
entries.pattern: get ready for work + at/in + time
examples: I get ready for work in about thirty minutes.
He gets ready for work the night before by packing his bag.

entries.definition_vi: chuẩn bị bữa sáng
examples: My father prepares breakfast for the family on Saturdays.
I prepare breakfast the night before when I have an early shift.

entries.definition_vi: chuẩn bị và mang theo bữa trưa
examples: I pack a lunch for work to save money.
She packed a lunch for her son before he left for school.

entries.definition_vi: rời khỏi nhà, đi ra ngoài
examples: I leave the house at half past seven to avoid traffic.
She checks her keys before she leaves the house.

entries.definition_vi: đi lại từ nhà đến nơi làm việc
examples: I commute to work by train four days a week.
She commutes to work by bicycle when the weather is good.

entries.definition_vi: đi làm các việc vặt như mua đồ hoặc gửi bưu phẩm
examples: I run errands after work so my weekend stays free.
He spent the afternoon running errands around town.

entries.definition_vi: giặt quần áo
examples: I do the laundry on Friday evenings.
We do the laundry together instead of leaving it for the weekend.

entries.definition_vi: rửa bát đĩa
examples: I wash the dishes after dinner while my sister dries them.
He washed the dishes before sitting down to watch a film.

entries.definition_vi: thư giãn sau giờ làm
examples: I unwind after work by walking through the park.
She likes to unwind after work with a book and a cup of tea.

entries.definition_vi: thức khuya
examples: I stayed up late to finish a report and felt tired the next day.
We rarely stay up late during the working week.

entries.definition_vi: đi ngủ sớm
entries.pattern: go to bed early + before + event
examples: I go to bed early when I have an exam the next morning.
She went to bed early because she had to catch a six o'clock train.
collocations: go to bed early on weekdays

entries.definition_vi: duy trì một nếp sinh hoạt đều đặn
entries.pattern: stick to a routine + during + period
examples: I find it easier to sleep well when I stick to a routine.
It can be difficult to stick to a routine while travelling.

entries.definition_vi: thay đổi nếp sinh hoạt của mình
examples: I changed my routine to make more time for exercise.
She wants to change her routine because she often feels rushed.

entries.definition_vi: dành thời gian cho một việc hoặc một người
examples: I make time for reading even on busy days.
They make time for their friends every weekend.

entries.definition_vi: tranh thủ sắp xếp một buổi tập giữa lịch bận
entries.pattern: squeeze in a workout + before/after + activity
examples: I squeeze in a workout before my first meeting.
She squeezed in a short workout during her lunch break.

entries.definition_vi: trì hoãn một việc cần làm
entries.pattern: put off a task + until + time
examples: I try not to put off a task when it will take only five minutes.
He put off a difficult task until the end of the week.

entries.definition_vi: lên kế hoạch cho các việc trong ngày
examples: I plan the day while I drink my morning coffee.
She plans the day before opening her email.
